headline: Bangladesh women's cricket team drops to ninth in ODI rankings after Australia whitewash
summary: Following a 3-0 series whitewash by Australia, Bangladesh's women's cricket team has dropped two places to ninth in the latest ICC Women's ODI rankings, losing one rating point.
details: Bangladesh suffered an eight-wicket defeat to Australia in the third and final WODI in Brisbane on Wednesday. This loss contributed to their slip of two places to ninth in the latest ICC Women’s ODI rankings.

Before the start of the three-match series, Bangladesh was ranked seventh with 73 rating points. Pakistan also held 73 points but was placed just below Bangladesh, while the West Indies were ninth with 72 points.

After the 3-0 series whitewash in Australia, Bangladesh lost one rating point, moving them down to ninth. Consequently, Pakistan moved up one place to seventh with 73 points, and the West Indies climbed to eighth with the same 72 points as Bangladesh.

Meanwhile, Australia gained one rating point after completing their clean sweep in Brisbane. The reigning powerhouses now sit comfortably at the top of the rankings with 164 points, significantly ahead of second-placed England, who have 126 points.
caption:

headline: 3 late goals stun Roma as Real Madrid complete astonishing 4-3 comeback
summary: The 15-time European champions scored three times in the final six minutes to turn a 3-2 deficit into a victory at the Stadio Olimpico.
details: Real Madrid secured a dramatic 4-3 away win over Roma in the Champions League on Wednesday, scoring three goals in the final six minutes of the match.
Roma took an early lead through Marten de Roon in the 20th minute, but Kylian Mbappe marked his 100th Champions League appearance with a goal to level the score at the break.
Donyell Malen scored twice in six minutes early in the second half, putting Roma ahead 3-1 and seemingly securing the victory for the hosts.
However, Real Madrid fought back, with Carlos Espi and Endrick scoring within two minutes of each other to make it 3-3.
The turnaround was completed in the 90th minute when former Roma defender Antonio Rudiger scored the winning goal, leaving the Stadio Olimpico crowd stunned.
Kylian Mbappe's goal moved him into the all-time top five tournament scorers, overtaking Real Madrid legend Raul Gonzalez.
The result leaves Real Madrid with six points from their opening two league phase matches, while Roma are on one point.
caption:
From 3-1 down to a 4-3 win in the final minutes! Real Madrid's legendary comeback spirit strikes again.

Real Madrid secured a dramatic 4-3 away win over Roma in the Champions League on Wednesday, scoring three goals in the final six minutes of the match.

Roma took an early lead through Marten de Roon in the 20th minute, but Kylian Mbappe marked his 100th Champions League appearance with a goal to level the score at the break.

Donyell Malen scored twice in six minutes early in the second half, putting Roma ahead 3-1 and seemingly securing the victory for the hosts.

However, Real Madrid fought back, with Carlos Espi and Endrick scoring within two minutes of each other to make it 3-3.

The turnaround was completed in the 90th minute when former Roma defender Antonio Rudiger scored the winning goal, leaving the Stadio Olimpico crowd stunned.

Kylian Mbappe's goal moved him into the all-time top five tournament scorers, overtaking Real Madrid legend Raul Gonzalez.

The result leaves Real Madrid with six points from their opening two league phase matches, while Roma are on one point.
